description: Save the business's alert contacts and post-call escalation rules. Read get_operational_settings first: each list you send (notification_phone, notification_email, escalation_rules) replaces the whole saved list, so include the entries to keep. Listed phones get after-call summary texts and escalation texts (one-recipient alerts go to the first phone); listed emails get escalation emails. lead_alerts chooses every lead or qualified leads only, and kaicalls_updates_enabled turns KaiCalls product and setup mail on or off (both default to quiet for a business a partner set up). Saving does not prove delivery.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token has exactly one accessible business)

dry_run.description: Validate and show the proposed settings without writing.

email_notifications.description: Enable or disable email staff alerts for this business.

escalation_rules.description: Post-call escalation rules checked against each finished call. Replaces the saved rules. Each rule is { id?, when, then, enabled? }.

then.description: Action keys. text_owner (the only one) texts and emails every alert contact above, not only the owner.

when.description: Natural-language trigger, e.g. "Caller needs a same-day callback from the recovery room".

kaicalls_updates_enabled.description: KaiCalls product news, setup tips, weekly summaries and account nudges to this business. Off by default for a business set up by a partner. Billing receipts and team invitations always go. null = account default.

lead_alert_min_score.description: Exact lead score bar for alerts (0 = every lead). Overrides lead_alerts. null = account default.

lead_alerts.description: 'qualified' = alert only on leads scored 70+ and stop the per-call 'a call came in' texts and emails; 'all' = every real lead; 'default' = the account default (qualified for a business set up by a partner, else all).

notification_email.description: Email addresses that get escalation emails. Replaces the saved list. Comma-separated string or array.

notification_phone.description: Phones that get alert texts; the first also gets one-recipient alerts. Replaces the saved list. Comma-separated string or array.

sms_notifications.description: Enable or disable SMS staff alerts for this business.

name: configure_staff_alerts
title: Configure Staff Alerts
